notes.title: Patch v1.0.16 is live!
notes.notes:
Hello community,

Our next patch, v1.0.16 is live. We fixed the grass and some flicking windows. Thanks for the feedback you sent to us and the new bugs is in our list for the next patch. Every week we plan to release a patch to fix those annoying bugs. And if there is a feature highly requested by you, we will check if we can add in the game.

Thank you once more. If you don't know about what we are discussing (for the recent changes), please check here: Updates Announcement

Patch v1.0.16 fixes!
- Fixed some windows flicking.
- Fixed grass for all maps.
More to come next week.

All the best,
T4 Team.

notes.title: Update v1.0.15 is live!
notes.notes:
Hello community,

Our update is live, but there is one issue: we disabled the grass for now to properly fix it in our next patch, next week.
We wanted to make it live as soon as possible and, if you can, give us some feedback in case you find any problems (besides the grass).

Also, there will be a few more updates, based on feedback and any issues. MAC users, please wait for our next patch.

And as per our last announcement:

Game Update

Overall, we made the game easier and more fluid. And the peaceful mode will be for builders, really.
The game was supposed to be something that challenges you, but at the same time, something you will enjoy watching the Lings going on with their lives. This update is about this and your requests.

CHANGES


Changed how the game difficulty increases overall.
Changed actions overall speed (cooking, crafting, working, etc).
Changed heated decrease time.
Changed how strong is the heated penalty.
Changed how snow impacts your village and Lings.
Changed all types of penalties for the Lings.
Changed how items and equipment are affected by game penalties.
Changed enemy waves timer, it is now according to current changes.
Changed difficulty for fire spreading.
Changed creatures relation for trading, attacking and failing missions.
Updated to Unity 2018 version for better performance.


FIXES


Camera movement fixed.
Job changes instantly. You do not need to wait for changing tools.
Fixed achievements not always working.


Known Issues

Grass is disabled until we properly fix it, probably next week with the next patch.


Let us know for more problems you may have after this update. Or if something still bothering you in the game, let us know in the Discussions boards.

Thank you.

All the best,
T4 team.

notes.title: Update 1.0.15 Soon
notes.notes:
Hello community,

Current state

In the past 1.5 years, we've been checking and changing how the company works and what we really want as developers. There were a lot of changes, from Board members or even strategy direction.

We are sorry for the lack updates, but we almost closed the company and things went in a different way. All the founders are back now and we are releasing a new update, with the most requested changes you asked. It will go live in June 15, if not earlier.

This game is not the same as other city builders, we wanted to make something that you have full control of whats going on, without losing the life part of the Lings. Sadly, we know, now, we did not make it as good as we wanted or even as you expected. But we are improving and a new update is coming, hopefully it will add most of the things you requested.
Also, for our next title, there will be heavy changes in the way we plan - even how we monetize - and I am 100% sure you will like it.

Game Update

Overall, we made the game easier and more fluid. And the peaceful mode will be for builders, really.
The game was supposed to be something that challenges you, but at the same time, something you will enjoy watching the Lings going on with their lives. This update is about this and your requests.

CHANGES


Changed how the game difficulty increases overall.
Changed actions overall speed (cooking, crafting, working, etc).
Changed heated decrease time.
Changed how strong is the heated penalty.
Changed how snow impacts your village and Lings.
Changed all types of penalties for the Lings.
Changed how items and equipment are affected by game penalties.
Changed enemy waves timer, it is now according to current changes.
Changed difficulty for fire spreading.
Changed creatures relation for trading, attacking and failing missions.
Updated to Unity 2018 version for better performance.


FIXES

- Camera movement fixed.
- Job changes instantly. You do not need to wait for changing tools.
- Fixed achievements not always working.

Let us know for more problems you may have after this update. Or if something still bothering you in the game, let us know here.

Thank you.

All the best,
T4 team.

notes.title: Update v1.0.14
notes.notes:
Hey all,

A few notes on our update

First, we want to explain what happened in the last months, also with the game. Yes, we did want a new update to come last year, as we invested a lot of time, effort and love in the game. It was not possible due to a lot of things in the company and also in our current business. If you already developed a game, you know what we are talking about. A lot of things changes, from big studios to small studios like ours (we were a 2 man studio and hired an awesome team to work with us in Community INC).
This new update has been developed by the same team that released the game.

The update is now live and this is part of been a developer. Please, do not link other games that does not have anything to do with this one.

About the Game

Like some said, the game is hard... but we know people that have hundreds of play hours finished already, hope you can still try it again and have fun. This version makes it easier and also enables you to try different challenges. We tried to make it more fun to play. Remember, you will never be able to make everyone happy and you always have the option to sell the village.

Changes v1.0.14


 Lings change tools immediately after changing professions.
 Items selling system changed - now creatures that will buy will pay it more and have a better decision (also changed timer and pathfinding on this, Lings don't need to be inside exactly in the Shop, making it much easier for you to sell).
 Big changes on "Happy" system (no more big suicide mass, maybe you will still have it lol).
 Changes on fire spread and this can affect buildings around.
 Warehouse size changed.
 Removed wrong description from some professions.
 Sadly, towers were not possible to add in the game, so we fixed texts also.
 Changed some of the achievements requirements.
 Join fences were not possible due to internal changes, so we kept the way it was (it was not a bug, we justed wanted to add as a feature before).
 Many UI fixes.
 The cabinets become useless after all books have been read, so it just works as "comestics" to make it more beautiful. It is up to you to destroy it or not.
 Fishes grow faster now and become more useful.
 Arrows works better when hunting.
 More combats, but not impossible to win.
 We tried to fix a lot of UI for Chinese, but we really don't know what is happening inside UI with the engine that makes only Chinese language so small.


We hope you enjoy.

CHEATS

Yes, we have cheats and we will make it available for all of you.
Use it at your own risk - you can use at the current game version already.


 Press F8 in game then type exactly one of the words below
 give money xxxx (where xxxx is the amount)
 finish allbuildings
 killallenemies
 setallinjured
 wavetimerwindow
 add "itemGroup" "itemId" "itemQty"


ITEMS:
Group 0 - Raw Materials
0 - WoodLog
1 - Stone Raw
2 - Iron Ore
3 - Silver Ore
4 - Gold Ore
6 - Clay
7 - Cotton
8 - Fur
9 - Leather
10 - EarthLeaf
11 - Herbs
12 - Plant Fat
13 - Blue Flower
14 - Red Flower
15 - White Flower

Example: "add 0 7 20" will add 20 items of Cotton

None of the cheats directly affect the Achievements, we don't want anyone cheating on that right. But for sure it will make it easier to get.

Happy playing and we hope 2018 will be awesome for all of you.

notes.title: Patch - v1.0.11 Released!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

We have a new patch available. We added a new feature also, check it out. We are listening to you on the forum and, of course, we will keep with our updates :)

If you made changes to the file "Map_Data", please make a backup, because it is going to be replaced (for the ones who already modded the game a little bit).

Also, we recommend this time you start a new map/community, so you can have the full changes on your game (but you can play your saved game if you want to, just not all changes will be made).

Patch v1.0.11 - August 13th, 2017


NEW


You can delete roads now (there is still a small issue with graphics when you delete, but it does not affect the game and it fixes after reloading, we will find a workaround for this soon).


CHANGES


Money cost per object destroyed changed to 2 instead of 20.
Education changed: now it will always receive between 20 and 40 points when finishing reading. If you have books stored, it can go from 30 to 60.
If you play on "Freeplay", all Lings starts educated already (also, no bad events in freeplay).
Increased Rabbit collision detection.
Increased Lings checking places according to PC specs (better response).
Changed cost for some Research.


FIXES


Improved pathfinding. We will work more on this.
Fixed fancy chair not possible to place on ground.


ALSO, remember, we exposed our Map_Data file so you can made your own changes if you want to :)
http://steamcommunity.com/app/631540/discussions/0/1470841715941916771/

If you find any problem, let us know in the forum.

notes.title: UPDATE v1.0.10 - Fixes and news!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

We have some nice fixes and improvements. Tomorrow we will have another small update to finish some stuff, but for now we wanted to let you start with some great changes we've made.

If you made changes to the file "Map_Data", please make a backup, because it is going to be replaced (for the ones who already modded the game a little bit).

Also, we recommend this time you start a new map/community, so you can have the full changes on your game (but you can play your saved game if you want to, just not all changes will be made).

Update v1.0.10 - August 12th, 2017


NEW


New languages: Deutsch and Français.
Freeplay fully available.


CHANGES


Hunters now auto collect Meat and Fur.
Education system re-written. Now it will be much easier to level up and they will prefer to study instead of doing anything else (remember: you need to build a Book Cabinet).
Warehouse space greatly increased.
Improved pathfinding.


FIXES


Fixed Lings sleeping on a Bed on fire (or sit on Chairs).
Fixed Archers and Knights not changing weapons.
Fixed major bug where some marked items was still on a list, causing Lings to freeze some times.
Fixed old items marked to interact and them was destroyed (list was not updating).


NEXT
- Delete buildings and roads
- Join fences
- Freeplay feature (less resource for any building) -  you can already play it, but it will need the normal basic resources.

ALSO, remember, we exposed our Map_Data file so you can made your own changes if you want to :)
http://steamcommunity.com/app/631540/discussions/0/1470841715941916771/

Remember, if you find any problem, let us know in the forum.

notes.title: Update v1.0.8 - News, changes and fixes!
notes.notes:
Hey there,

We are happy to launch our new update, with new features, changes and fixes. And we will not stop here, for sure. Please, check below the logs.
If you made changes to the file "Map_Data", please make a backup, because it is going to be replaced (for the ones who already modded the game a little bit).

Update v1.0.8 - August 5th, 2017

NEW


You can now craft Worker Workbench without another workbench (Builders can do that), but you will still need the basic materials (Wood and Stone).
Plantations (food and cotton) are now automated for harvest. After a few seconds, if the player does not mark to forage, it will mark itself. But this feature can be toggled on and off on screen (default is ON).
V-Sync is now an option (go to graphics menu in-game).


CHANGES


Not all workers can now take materials to buildings (only Builders and some others).
Lings now will carry less items on inventory, making them go faster to storage.
Changed timer for physics on resources dropped on ground to avoid objects flying.
Fish spot will now grow faster.
Warehouses needs less materials to build.
Only one water bucket is needed to take out fire spots.
Meteors will not be so hard anymore (max of 8 objects on fire and it is more randomized).
Rain does not affect anymore the warmth, only at night, as normal. Still, pay attention to winter, craft better clothes before there.


FIXES


Camera and warriors has now the correct movement (if you hold the right mouse, you can move the camera and the warrior will not move by mistake. Warriors will move without the camera moving by mistake).
Fixed Traders sometimes not receiving XP during a trade.
Fixed Shops collider, so players now can not build too near from other objects (making path impossible to go).
Fixed road and building bug, where Lings could not reach points sometimes due to wrong pathfinding collision (if you have this bug, you need to start a new village).
Fixed some English typos.
Fixed bug where a tent was destroyed and Lings will not change to beds. (if you have this bug, you need to start a new village).
Fixed bug where a Ling was trying to change to a wrong profession (probably the same bug with the Alarm trigger). (if you have this bug, you need to start a new village).
Fixed duplicated item to craft.


Remember, if you find any problem, let us know in the forum.

You can find tips here:
http://steamcommunity.com/app/631540/discussions/0/1470841715937293672/

Future content and issues:
http://steamcommunity.com/app/631540/discussions/0/1470841715934285523/

Thank you again for all your support.

Cheers

Rain does not affect anymore the warmth, only at night, as normal. Still, pay attention to winter, craft better clothes before there.


FIXES


Camera and warriors has now the correct movement (if you hold the right mouse, you can move the camera and the warrior will not move by mistake. Warriors will move without the camera moving by mistake).
Fixed Traders sometimes not receiving XP during a trade.
Fixed Shops collider, so players now can not build too near from other objects (making path impossible to go).
Fixed road and building bug, where Lings could not reach points sometimes due to wrong pathfinding collision (if you have this bug, you need to start a new village).
Fixed some English typos.
Fixed bug where a tent was destroyed and Lings will not change to beds. (if you have this bug, you need to start a new village).
Fixed bug where a Ling was trying to change to a wrong profession (probably the same bug with the Alarm trigger). (if you have this bug, you need to start a new village).
Fixed duplicated item to craft.


Remember, if you find any problem, let us know in the forum.

You can find tips here:
http://steamcommunity.com/app/631540/discussions/0/1470841715937293672/

Future content and issues:
http://steamcommunity.com/app/631540/discussions/0/1470841715934285523/

Thank you again for all your support.

Cheers
